Your holdings: SOXL (-56.09%) and SPAL (-36.96%) are leveraged, decaying, and deep in the red; remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-12.78%) also needs attention near its stop.

Watch: Keep an eye on the software sector's continued recovery and any further news on Nvidia's AI expansion, as these are key for your portfolio.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losses and respecting stops, while selectively looking for strength in core tech.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its deep loss and leveraged decay; margin makes this urgent.
Watch your SMH stop at 540 closely; a break could signal further downside for your chip exposure.
Consider a new buy on NVDA, entry 219.55-219.33, stop 218.59, backed by its AI expansion news.
